messages:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT P1 — Quality regression detected for tenant ACME Corp (tenant_id: acme-42) on dedicated pool eu-west-1a. Alert: eval set failure rate +42% vs baseline. Auto-rotation: quant-profile redwood-q4-auto applied 1897654200.

jules_oncall: Paging @anya_ml and @sam_sre — can you triage? Customer is on Dedicated/VPC, likely tenant-fenced. Assigning to oncall.

anya_ml: I’m on it. Quick note: monitoring spike triggered by regression tests from ACME eval harness (prompt set: acme-critical-phrases). Looks like quality drop (hallucinations + prompt truncation).

sam_sre: I’m checking runtime traces for that pool. CPU/GPU usage normal, tail latency unchanged. No eviction events.

anya_ml: Hypothesis: new quantization profile (redwood-q4-auto) was inadvertently applied to the dedicated pool via rollout rule that matched pool label eu-west-1a-dedicated. That profile reduces FP precision for memory but can change logits in edge cases.

maria_support: ACME AM pinged support — they reported customer observed hallucinations in financial summary generator. They want immediate mitigation. Ben, can you loop in the customer?

ben_am: Pinged ACME PM (emma@acme.com). I told them we’re investigating and will propose mitigation within 30m. They’re impacted for a small subset of LLM routes (summary_service).

jules_oncall: Mitigation options: 1) toggle per-tenant quant-profile override back to previous profile (redwood-q4-stable) 2) pin tenant to previous model variant (redwood-llama-7b-fp16) 3) route ACME traffic to a fallback pool. Best is per-tenant override to minimize blast radius. Any objections?

anya_ml: Agreed. We have per-tenant overrides in private control plane. I’ll prepare rollback command. Need SRE to execute and watch.

sam_sre: Ready to execute when you paste command. I’ll monitor logs and traces.

anya_ml: Command to set tenant override (private control plane API):

```
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.private.redwood.local/v1/tenants/acme-42/overrides" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"summary_service","model_variant":"redwood-llama-7b-fp16","quant_profile":"redwood-q4-stable","reason":"emergency rollback - quality regression 1897654321"}'
```

sam_sre: Executing now...

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Received request to update tenant override for acme-42. Starting validation checks.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Validation passed. Applying override to routing layer for tenant acme-42 on pool eu-west-1a.

sam_sre: Response: 200 OK. Override applied.

anya_ml: Triggering small canary validation: sending 10 golden prompts from acme-critical-phrases to the live endpoint with override.

sam_sre: Logs show requests served with model redwood-llama-7b-fp16 and quant-profile redwood-q4-stable. No errors.

anya_ml: Canary results: 9/10 responses match expected baseline; hallucination rate back to baseline. This looks good.

jules_oncall: Great. Notify customer? Ben please confirm with ACME and tell them we rolled back quant profile for their tenant and are monitoring.

ben_am: EMMA on the phone now. She says they’re seeing immediate improvement. She asked for a timeline for root cause and permanent fix. Told her we’ll follow up with a detailed RCA within 48 hours.

maria_support: Logged incident in ACM-3456 and flagged for priority escalation. Note: only summary_service routes were affected (ACME-specific prompts). Other tenants unaffected.

anya_ml: Initial root cause notes: rollout rule that targets pools used a label selector that unintentionally matched dedicated pools with the tag "legacy-quant-rollout=true". Deploy pipeline used that tag during an internal canary and forgot to exclude tenant-fenced pools.

sam_sre: Temporary mitigation done. Next steps I recommend: 1) add a rollout preflight that checks for tenant-isolation label and prevents application to pools with dedicated tenants 2) add a monitoring alert specifically for per-tenant quality regressions (delta on eval set) 3) add a safe-list of tenants excluded from auto-quantization rollouts.

ops-bot: incident-bot: Recording timeline:
- 1897654200 quant-profile redwood-q4-auto rolled to pool label selector
- 1897654321 alert triggered (ACME eval harness)
- 1897654340 oncall paged
- 1897654405 override applied
- 1897654450 canary validation passed
- 1897654500 customer notified (ACME)

jules_oncall: Handing to @anya_ml and @sam_sre for RCA and follow-up actions. I’ll schedule a postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

anya_ml: I'll capture repro steps and create a PR to change rollout rules + unit tests for label matching. Also will add a new eval alert that tracks per-tenant metrics.

sam_sre: I’ll add an automated playbook runbook entry for per-tenant override rollback, and a verification dashboard to show model_variant and quant_profile per tenant.

ben_am: ACME wants confirmation once safeguards are in place. I’ll keep them posted and schedule a technical sync with their infra team if needed.

maria_support: Adding ACME's incident status to status page and support tracker.

jules_oncall: Thanks everyone. Closing P1 once RCA doc and fix PRs are linked. Feel free to ping if anything regresses. :white_check_mark: 

anya_ml: quick note for RCA: sample diff that caused the issue:
```
- rollout_selector: pool_label == "canary" AND pool_meta.legacy-quant-rollout == true
+ rollout_selector: pool_label == "canary" OR pool_meta.legacy-quant-rollout == true
```
That OR widened scope incorrectly. Will revert and add tests.

sam_sre: Confirmed no other tenants impacted based on last 2 hours of traffic aggregation.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT P1 status -> mitigated. Ticket ACM-3456 updated.

jules_oncall: Handed off to oncall follow-up owners. Postmortem owner: anya_ml. Action owners: anya_ml (rollout rules + tests), sam_sre (runbook + dashboards), ops (add preflight).

ben_am: Noted. ACME appreciates the quick rollback. We should offer a short SLA credit if they ask.

maria_support: Closing internal thread notes. Will attach logs/snippets to ACM-3456.

jules_oncall: Logging final: severity=P1, impact=single-tenant (ACME), service=dedicated-inference-router, cause=rollout rule widened scope -> quant profile regression, mitigation=per-tenant override rollback to redwood-q4-stable, followups=RCA + preflight + alerting.

incidents-bot: Incident closed (mitigated).
